name: pane-style
title: Style
description: Base style for Pane. Installs the shared dependencies and the --pane-* design tokens — blur, saturation, tint, border, highlight and shadow — for light and dark.

name: pane
title: Pane
description: The glass primitive every other component is built on — a refracted rim, a tinted backdrop, and a specular highlight that follows the pointer. Ships regular and clear variants, and flattens automatically when nested.

name: button
title: Button
description: A glass button in default and destructive variants across four sizes, with asChild support via Radix Slot.

name: card
title: Card
description: A glass card with header, title, description, action, content and footer parts.

name: badge
title: Badge
description: A compact glass badge in default and tinted variants, with asChild support for linking.

name: input
title: Input
description: A text input on a clear glass surface that raises a highlight ring on focus and dims when disabled.

name: switch
title: Switch
description: A Radix switch whose thumb is a glass pane, moved by a spring rather than a CSS transition.

name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Radix tabs on a glass list, with a pane indicator that animates between triggers.

name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A Radix tooltip rendered as a small glass pane, with provider, trigger and content parts.

name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: A Radix dialog whose panel is a glass pane over a blurred overlay, with header, footer, title and description parts.

name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: A Radix sheet that slides in from any of the four sides as a floating, inset glass panel.
